inputs._nrm_layer_alternates_doc: rc8 switch prep 2026-10-03 (review HIGH): the RC's NRM layer = the layer the NRM option ships = the first of nrm_layer_pattern + these whose NRM_LAYER_REPORT.json has the tier nrm_tier (T2W = Wylder on: the option title promises Wylder's skills; the RC8 lane builds it as nrm_<rc>). A layer of another tier is refused by the package check (rcinputs.nrm_package_problems; --final always). beta.16 RCs (rc1-rc7) only have nrm_<rc>_T2, so they are TEST builds only.
inputs._dmn_layer_doc: Final pass 2026-10-03: the Deflect Me Not layers (dmn\dmn_layer.py) of the RC: plain = on the RC chain, nrm = on the NRM layer + the chain. Each must report fail [] and be made from that chain (rcinputs.py). They ship only the files their DMN_LAYER_REPORT.json shipping_files list; Rei Jr.'s files that a layer ships unchanged come from the player's DMN download (archive dmn). DMN + NRM layer = the first of dmn_nrm_layer_pattern + dmn_nrm_layer_alternates made from exactly the NRM layer + the chain (rc8: dmn_nrmw_rc8 on nrm_rc8 = Wylder on; the rc3-rc7 test builds: dmn_nrm_<rc>).
inputs._dmn_ercap_only_doc: Luka 2026-10-03 (after field-testing RC8 + Wylder + DMN + ERCap: 'everything positive'): players who tick BOTH Deflect Me Not and Nightreign Movement get Nightreign 0.2 WITH Wylder, and the installer adds ERCapacityExpansion automatically (the D rule below). That DMN + NRM layer (dmn_nrmw_<rc>, made on the Wylder NRM layer itself) is over the old animation wall by design: its report fails exactly G-WALL + G-VOL-REC and it is accepted ONLY as an ERCap state - its DMN_ERCAP_STATE.json (dmn\dmn_ercap_state.py) accepted, made from the same roots, the same manifest, M2 last index in 32,668..65,433, every shipped file unchanged (rcinputs.dmn_layer_problems, ported from deploy_v65.py --dmn-nrmw). This list names the DMN layers ('plain', 'nrm') that may be such an ERCap-only state; the pipeline then requires every combination that uses one to measure over the no-DLL limit (so the installer forces the DLL) and every such combination to carry a D rule (its reason). The Wylder-off sibling arrangement of the rc8 switch prep (nrm_<rc>_T2 + dmn_nrm_<rc>) was retired the same day.
inputs._nrm_menu_doc: rc8 switch prep 2026-10-03: NRM 0.2 ships menu\hi\01_common.* (its skill icons), the same two files Lucy ships (her icon). Lucy + NRM gets Lucy's pair with NRM's changed layout + texture put in, made by the RC lane's own composer (the files deploy_v65.py installs for the field test); the pipeline adopts the composed pair from nrm_menu_tested_pattern when its sources are exactly this build's, else runs the composer into work\lucy_nrm_menu\<rc>\ (products.ensure_nrm_menu).
inputs._infdur_ack_doc: SpEffect ids with a finite duration that the RC regulation adds and Infinite Durations must NOT make infinite (accepted on every build, merged with release.py --infdur-ack): DMN's 240 rows (F64f, inert without DMN; DMN_LAYER_DESIGN.md 3.1): every new SpEffect row of rc7's regulation except 800000711 (which merge_final.json lists, like 800000710), measured 2026-10-03 by the pipeline's own new-row check (241 new rows, 70 with a finite duration). rc8 switch prep 2026-10-03: + Nightreign Movement 0.2's 139 helper rows that RC8's F68n adds (9950210-9950864: collision receipts, animation / sound / visual event carriers, ability cooldown events; 0.01-1.5 s; inert without NRM) - making them infinite would break NRM's skills. MEASURED on rc8 by the same check: 386 new rows, 209 finite; with these every finite one is listed or acknowledged.
inputs._lucy_doc: Lucy's workspace folder and build recipe are specific to the build PC: pipeline\cfg.py reads them from the LOCAL file catalog\lucy_build.local.json (keys root, recipe; never pushed). The two patterns below name the per-RC base and build folders inside that workspace.

wall._doc: Metric = size of the c0000 clip list (union of every TAE action id and every HKX animation id, sorted by bank*1e6+sub) over the 14 c0000 anibnds + c0000_dlc01/dlc02 (probes\ERCAP_SEAMLESS.md section C). Every entry must sit below the signed-16 wall, so the list may hold at most 32768 entries without ERCapacityExpansion. With it, at most 65534; we keep a margin.

With Nightreign Movement's Wylder skill set picked, DMN's R1+R2+Y moveset toggle shares buttons with Onslaught Stake: switch Wylder off at a Site of Grace to use the toggle.

_rules_doc: Kinds: Q (a requires b), X (conflict), W (warning on the Ready page, logged, in the marker), D (2026-10-03: a and b TOGETHER need the DLL component wall.dll_component; the installer switches it on by itself - the Options page shows it ticked and greyed with this text as its one-line reason, 'ERCapacityExpansion - <text>' - logs CXCXM RULE D, writes AUTO_ON=<dll id> into the marker so a later run that drops a or b removes it again unless the player ticked it himself; a silent explicit /ERCAP=0 is refused). Luka 2026-10-03: DMN + NRM ships NRM 0.2 WITH Wylder (dmn_nrmw_<rc>, 187 entries past the old animation wall, field-proven with the DLL) - the D rule replaces the rc8 switch prep's W rule 'installed without Wylder's skills'. The pipeline requires the D rules to cover exactly the combinations whose measured animation total is over the no-DLL limit (pipeline\wall.py check_forced). The W rule: the field test's INFERRED-then-confirmed clash (repair 1 of the Wylder lane: NRM's Onslaught combo reads Y held + R2 held and hides ACTION_ARM_R2 / ACTION_ARM_ACTION from c0000.hks while it is held). Final pass 2026-10-03: the warning 'Seamless Co-op together with ERCapacityExpansion is untested' was dropped - field-confirmed 2026-10-02 (single PC, hosting, and a real 2-PC Seamless session, with DMN + NRM + Lucy).

legacy._doc: Older releases: used ONLY to preselect options and to remove obsolete files. Read-only inputs.
legacy._catalogs_doc: Repair 4: the catalog.json of every EARLIER release of this installer (e.g. "${INST}\dist\v6.5.0\catalog.json" for v6.6). Each content it gives a path counts as that path's own older content (H rules: never taken for another mod's file), its paths the new release no longer writes become obsolete files, its changelog an old changelog, its regulations InfDur states. release.py --final refuses a build when an earlier dist\<tag>\catalog.json is not listed here. Empty for v6.5 (the first release of this installer).
legacy._packages_doc: NRM-era fix 2026-10-03 (rc8 one-command run: P4 p4_v64 uninstall left v6.4's mod\action\script\nrm-extension.hks behind, P10 r3 DT): other authors' packages an older release was built from or a player put in by hand. Every file under a 'map' prefix (zip member prefix -> folder under mod\) and every sha256 the package's own manifest lists for a mapped path (its own files + 'originalSHA256' = every earlier version it replaces) is an older content of that path: H rules of the paths its 'component' writes only while it is on (the installer's '-1' removal and the uninstall then take them for that option's own files, never for another mod's). A package's contents may only meet its own component's paths (the build stops otherwise); they are never obsolete rows. 'sha256' pins the zip. beta.16 = the package v6.4's NRM option and the v6.5 rc1-rc7 test builds were made from (their merged nrm-extension.hks 8e7b453a... comes from the v6.4 zips above); 0.2 = the players' download now (its manifest names beta.16's files and every earlier NRM version's). Measured 2026-10-03: the rc1-rc7 NRM layers, dmn_nrm_rc3-rc7 and the rc7 installer catalogs hold no other content at an NRM-only path.
